defects.step: Step 6 — the flywheel skeleton (the manifest row-count check on its ✓ line) — FOUND, FIXED BY THE COORDINATOR MID-RUN, RE-RUN AND RE-PASSED
defects.what: The first pass stopped here: the ✓ assertion compared a whole-file row grep of docs/tools-manifest.md against the header's LIVE-row figure, but the manifest carries a twelfth table, '## Superseded — pointers only' (28 rows), that the same header excludes from the live count. The manifest was internally consistent (293 live rows across the eleven phase tables, matching the per-phase figures) and byte-identical to the kit master apart from the one prescribed prepended line, so the check was wrong, not the file. The kit's census tool now states live, superseded and total in the Coverage line ('Table rows in all: 321') and Step 6 compares against that total; Step 6 was re-run unchanged and passed 321 == 321.
defects.output: before: $ command grep -c '^| `' docs/tools-manifest.md -> 321 vs "of which 293 live rows" -> FAIL ;; after the fix: 321 vs "Table rows in all: 321" -> PASS
defects.fix: Applied (the second of the two fixes suggested at the stop): both sides of the check are now derived by the census tool — the header states live, superseded pointer and total row counts, and Step 6's ✓ line compares the whole-file grep against the total.
